description: This file defines CMake macros for building and linking libraries, generating parser code with Lemon, and setting target properties within a CMake build script.

methods.name: ADD_AND_INSTALL_LIBRARY
methods.description: Defines a macro to add, optionally link, and install a library based on build configuration and platform.

methods.name: LEMON_PARSER
methods.description: Defines a macro to generate Lemon parser C and header files for a given source file.

methods.name: ADD_TARGET_PROPERTIES
methods.description: Defines a macro to add specified properties to a build target.
